def bubbleSort(arr, n):
    for i in range(n - 1):
        for j in range(n - i - 1):
            if arr[j] > arr[j + 1]:
                arr[j], arr[j + 1] = arr[j + 1], arr[j]

def main():
    n = int(input())
    a = list(map(int, input().split()))
    bubbleSort(a, n)
    if n == 1:
        print(a[0])
    else:
        print(a[n // 2])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
